headline: Executive order creates an advisory committee on human radiation experiments.
what_it_does: This order sets up an Advisory Committee on Human Radiation Experiments. Based on its title, the committee's job is to look into and advise the government on experiments that exposed people to radiation. No summary was provided, so details about the committee's exact duties, members, and deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: People who took part in government-linked radiation experiments, and their families
who_it_affects.how: The committee was set up to look into experiments that may have involved them.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in radiation research
who_it_affects.how: Their past work with human subjects is the likely focus of the committee's review.
